process.title: Four steps from message to launch
process.text: No bureaucracy: you describe the task, you get a price, a deadline and a working result.

steps.title: Request
steps.text: Message me on Telegram, Viber or WhatsApp and describe the task in your own words.

steps.title: Quote & deadline
steps.text: I ask a few questions, then fix the price and delivery date before any work starts.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: I build and show progress along the way — changes are handled as we go.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: You get the finished project, a short walkthrough, and I stay reachable.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.text: If your question isn't here, just message me — I'll answer personally.

items.q: How much does a website or bot cost?
items.a: A Telegram bot starts at $25 for the base version with a simple admin panel. A website starts at $75 (domain purchased separately). A Python script is $50–200 depending on the task. The exact price is set before work begins, after a short discussion.
50% upfront before work starts, the rest once the finished result is delivered. I accept bank card payments or USDT (TRC20 network).

items.q: What does “first 5 orders are free” mean?
items.a: I'm building up a portfolio, so the first 5 projects are free of charge. The only condition is that the finished work can be shown as a portfolio case. Spots are limited.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A simple bot or landing page takes 2–4 days. A project with complex logic, payments and integrations can take a week or more.

items.q: Are domain and hosting included in the website price?
items.a: No, you buy the domain yourself so it's registered in your name. Hosting for simple sites is usually free (Vercel) — I set it up and connect your domain.

items.q: What if I need changes after delivery?
items.a: Small fixes within the agreed scope are included. For ongoing maintenance there's a support plan from $20 per month.

contacts.title: Let's talk about your project
contacts.text: Describe what you need — I'll work out the cost and suggest a solution.
